label: GO-only; large after reaching S1 (esp. rewarded a1 S1), scaled by S1-good belief; ~0 after S2
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 1) * np.clip(belief_lo, -3, 3) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == -1) * np.clip(belief_lo, -3, 3) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == -1) * (prev_reward == 1)
explanation: Fires only at GO (D1/D2 are 0). Magnitude is set by the last observed state and outcome plus the ideal-observer belief that S1 is good. After the previous trial reached S2 (any choice or reward) it is pushed down to about 0 (weight -1.0). After an S1 trial it is high, highest after a rewarded common a1->S1 (+1.3 on top), a little higher after unrewarded a1 S1 (+0.25), and in both cases it grows with belief_lo (clipped log-odds of S1 good, +0.35 per unit). On the window first trial, where the previous state is not in the data, belief_lo (+0.48) and the previous reward (+0.51) take its place. So it reads as an S1-favouring signal gated by the last state being S1, roughly an observed-only stand-in for the a1 policy. Six observed-only terms give dev R^2 beyond timing 0.85 and test 0.84. Reference ceilings: all 0.89, all observed 0.85, policy decile (model) 0.58, belief decile alone 0.45. Dropping model outputs costs almost nothing. The trial before the last one and an a2 S1 r indicator added nothing (weights near 0). Remaining errors are small: slight under-prediction after a1 S2 r and over-prediction on window-first trials.

issues: Wording overclaim: 'after an S1 trial it is high' is wrong for a2 S1 u. Its GO residual is -1.08, the same as after any S2 trial, so the feature is about 0 there. a2 S1 r is only +0.14. The fit gets this right only through the prev_state==1 * belief_lo slope (belief is low after a2 S1 u). An explicit a2 S1 u indicator takes weight -0.24 and adds just +0.0006 test R^2. The label should say 'after a1->S1 (or rewarded a2->S1)', not 'after S1'.

The +0.25 for a1 S1 u is not a stable effect. Adding (GO)*last_is('a1 S1 u')*(tv('reward',-2)==1) gets weight +0.56, and the plain a1 S1 u weight drops to -0.03 (test 0.8451). So after an unrewarded a1 S1 trial the feature stays high only when the trial before that was rewarded. The worst-fit windows show this: a1 S1 u after a1 S1 r has actual about 2.3 against predicted about 0.5. The gain is small, though.

Window-first GO steps are over-predicted by a systematic -0.26. This is the largest error class in misses, but the cause is missing data (the previous trial is not in the window), not a missing mechanism. A belief_lo>0 indicator on those steps lifts test R^2 only to 0.847.

Confirmed: the feature is exactly 0 at D1 and D2. S2-previous trials push it to about 0 (weight -1.04). The S1-belief slope matters: removing it drops test R^2 from 0.843 to 0.797. Test R^2 of 0.843 matches the 0.85 'all observed' ceiling, and the other errors (a1 S2 r +0.15, a2 S1 r +0.08) are small.
